departments.title: Medical Gastroenterology
departments.description: The Department of Medical Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Sri Ramakrishna Specialty Hospital is dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of digestive and liver disorders. Our expert team offers compassionate, comprehensive care using advanced technologies and personalized treatment plans. We manage conditions such as gastrointestinal diseases, liver disorders, inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), pancreatic issues, and gastrointestinal cancers. Our specialists are skilled in advanced diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopic procedures, including upper GI endoscopy, colonoscopy, ERCP with stenting, variceal banding, hemoclipping, esophageal stenting, polypectomy, and mucosal resection.
title02_list: Liver Disease Management (Hepatitis, Cirrhosis, Fatty Liver)
title03_list: Experienced Team: Skilled in managing complex GI and liver conditions
Advanced Technology: State-of-the-art diagnostic and therapeutic tools
Personalized Care: Tailored treatment with holistic patient support
departments.conclusion: Our mission is to provide high-quality, patient-focused care to help you achieve and maintain optimal digestive health.
